raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength - Beginner (Home, Mat + Doorway Bar)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational full-body strength with bodyweight and doorway bar"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundations" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Focus - Horizontal Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_wall_slides 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower Focus - Hinge & Squat":
        warmup:
          dynamic_leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          elevated_glute_bridge 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bodyweight_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_couch_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Vertical Pull/Push & Core":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assisted_pull_up 3x4..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Focus - Horizontal Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x35..50 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_wall_slides 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower Focus - Hinge & Squat":
        warmup:
          dynamic_leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          elevated_glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bodyweight_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          side_plank 3x25..40 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_couch_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Vertical Pull/Push & Core":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assisted_pull_up 3x5..9 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Focus - Progressive Overload":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_wall_slides 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Focus - Control & Volume":
        warmup:
          dynamic_leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_glute_bridge 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          bodyweight_squat 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_lunge 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_couch_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Vertical Pull/Push & Core":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assisted_pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_pike_push_up 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..40 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper - Strength Test & Build":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..75 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_wall_slides 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower - Strength Test & Build":
        warmup:
          dynamic_leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_glute_bridge 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          pistol_box_squat_assisted 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise_single_leg 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_couch_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Vertical - Strength Test & Build":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assisted_pull_up 4x7..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Strength & Complexity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Horizontal Strength & Core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jacks 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up_archetype_progression 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          elevated_feet_plank 3x35..60 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Strength - Single-Leg Emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking_lunges 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pistol_box_squat_assisted 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Nordic_curl_assisted 3x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge_hold 3x45..70 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_release 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Vertical Strength & Overhead":
        warmup:
          bandless_shoulder_prep 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up_negatives 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          decline_pike_push_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_knee_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push/Pull Balance":
        warmup:
          jumping_jacks 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diamond_push_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row_feet_elevated 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank_with_reach 3x20..40 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Explosive & Strength Lower":
        warmup:
          hip_openers 5m
        main straight_sets:
          shrimp_squat_assisted 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_romanian_deadlift_balance 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_release 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Vertical Strength & Core":
        warmup:
          bandless_shoulder_prep 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assisted_pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          windshield_wipers_progression 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Strength & Volume":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up_variation_progression 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 5x10..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Strength & Mobility":
        warmup:
          dynamic_leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pistol_box_squat_assisted 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Nordic_curl_assisted 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise_single_leg 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_couch_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Vertical Strength & Skill":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up_negatives 5x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_handstand_work 4x20..40 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_knee_raise 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Strength Test & Peak":
        warmup:
          jumping_jacks 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 5x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 4x45..90 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Strength Test & Peak":
        warmup:
          walking_lunges 5m
        main straight_sets:
          shrimp_squat_assisted 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_romanian_deadlift_balance 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_release 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Vertical Strength Test & Peak":
        warmup:
          bandless_shoulder_prep 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assisted_pull_up 5x6..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x30..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Consolidation & Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Consolidation - Horizontal":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          archer_push_up_progression 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row_weighted_progression 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          elevated_feet_plank 4x40..80 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Power & Strength":
        warmup:
          dynamic_leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pistol_squat_progression 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Nordic_curl_assisted 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_glute_bridge 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_couch_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Vertical Strength & Overhead":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          decline_pike_push_up 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Strength - Increase Intensity":
        warmup:
          jumping_jacks 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up_weighted_progression 5x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row_advanced 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x30..60 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Strength - Stability":
        warmup:
          walking_lunges 5m
        main straight_sets:
          shrimp_squat 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_romanian_deadlift_balance 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_release 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Vertical Strength - Pull/Push":
        warmup:
          bandless_shoulder_prep 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 5x4..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          handstand_push_up_progression 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          windshield_wipers 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Mixed Strength & Skill":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          mixed_push_progression 5x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          mixed_pull_progression 5x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          elevated_feet_plank 4x45..90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Consolidation":
        warmup:
          dynamic_leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pistol_squat 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Nordic_curl 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise_single_leg 4x12..20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_couch_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Vertical Consolidation":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 5x5..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          decline_pike_push_up 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "12-Week Peak - Upper":
        warmup:
          jumping_jacks 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x12..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 5x12..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x40..90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "12-Week Peak - Lower":
        warmup:
          walking_lunges 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pistol_squat 5x6..12 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Nordic_curl 5x6..12 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x12..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_couch_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "12-Week Peak - Vertical & Core":
        warmup:
          bandless_shoulder_prep 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 5x6..12 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          handstand_push_up_progression 5x4..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 4x12..20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5m
